born.why: The code prioritizes survival by starving-eating when critical, avoids known poisons unless starving, uses tasting for unknown fruits to build safety data without full risk when hunger is manageable, and stores known-safe fruit for later use via carrying.

The code prioritizes survival by eating only when starving, using taste to identify unknown fruits while managing hunger thresholds, and carrying known safe fruits for storage unless immediate hunger relief is needed.

The code prioritizes carrying known-safe species for pantry efficiency, uses tasting only for new/unverified species when hunger is low to minimize risk, and defaults to eating when starvation is imminent or hunger is high enough to justify the risk of unknown fruits.

The code prioritizes survival by eating immediately when starvation is imminent, uses pantry storage for known safe fruits to optimize energy management, and leverages trait-based analogy only for unknown fruits to minimize poisoning risk while allowing learning through cautious tasting.

The code prioritizes starvation avoidance, then leverages trait-based generalization (color/smell) to safely eat new species faster than relying solely on exact key matches, while using 'taste' to build the safety database when hunger permits.

The code enables Fagi to learn from experience by storing outcomes in her diary, safely carrying known-good fruits for later consumption while avoiding known-poisonous ones, and cautiously tasting unknown fruits only when not burdened by other items.

This code implements a trait-based learning system that groups fruits by smell and color rather than exact species, allowing Fagi to generalize knowledge even when fruit chemistry changes or new species appear. It uses a scoring system to weigh positive experiences against negative ones, ensuring she avoids highly risky traits (those linked to poison) unless starving, while preferring to "carry" fruits with a strong history of safety to save time and energy.
